blocks.text: Scottsdale homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Scottsdale, September 2026. Detached houses: 53 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 19% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 24 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 30 sold over 4 months against an average of 52.0 listed, about 6.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 9 sold over 4 months against an average of 25.2 listed, about 11.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 6 sold.

faq.q: What is Scottsdale Exchange, and is it in Delta?
faq.a: It is a TransLink bus exchange at the Scott Road / 72 Avenue node and the anchor of the OCP's Scottsdale Exchange TOD Area; the City states the exchange itself sits on the Surrey side of Scott Road, at the Delta border.
The R6 Scott Road RapidBus connects Scott Road Station with Newton Exchange, with a boarding area at Scott Road and 72nd Avenue.

faq.q: What does Bill 47 change near the exchange?
faq.a: The City states Bill 47 requires minimum densities within a Transit Oriented Development Area extending 400 metres from Scottsdale Exchange, and Delta adopted SSMUH zoning allowing combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites.

faq.q: Is a duplex in Scottsdale always a strata?
faq.a: No — the Province lists duplexes as a form strata housing can take, which means a duplex may be strata-titled or not; check the title and strata plan for a specific property.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Scottsdale address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. The SD37 locator result for 7031 120 St, Delta is Heath Elementary (K–7) and Seaquam Secondary (8–12); there is no middle tier in SD37, and catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator.
